hardware.hbm_capacity: knowledge base hw-tpu-7x via tpu-knowledge-base (https://docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/tpu7x, checked 2026-10-06): 192 GiB per chip / 2
hardware.peak_fp8: knowledge base hw-tpu-7x via tpu-knowledge-base (https://docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/tpu7x, checked 2026-10-06): 4614 TFLOP/s per chip / 2

hardware.mxu_min_dim: assumed: package rule, model/common/REQUIREMENTs.md s MXU; not stated by the knowledge base
hardware.vmem_bytes: JAX tpu_info.py via tpu-knowledge-base (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jax-ml/jax/fe025ad74d5a1641d9b82f7cea126593ecff68a8/jax/_src/tpu_info.py, retrieved 2026-10-06): SparseCore 16 vector subcores x 512 KiB = 8 MiB
hardware.hop_latency: assumed: 1.0 us, the collective.py default every earlier run used; not stated by the knowledge base and not measured separately. Measured fixed cost per collective on j-484cd4c0 is 13.5 us (collective.py)
hardware.peak_vpu_bf16: assumed: peak_bf16 / 16; not stated by the knowledge base, not measured
hardware.peak_vpu_fp32: assumed: peak_bf16 / 64; not stated by the knowledge base, not measured
hardware.d2d_hop_latency: assumed: equal to hop_latency, the value every earlier run used; not stated by the knowledge base, not measured
hardware.ici_contention: assumed: the two chiplets of a package share its ICI links equally (COLLECTIVE.md); not stated by the knowledge base
hardware.memory_utilization: vLLM --gpu-memory-utilization; 0.92 carried from the previous roofline.py default, not verified against the server launch
hardware.resident_overhead_gb: assumed: estimate of compiled graphs and workspace beyond weights; not measured
